text.en:
That part of Act Numbered Twenty-six hundred and fifty-seven, entitled "An Act constituting an
Administrative Code," contained in chapter fifty [one], sections twenty-five hundred and twenty to
twenty-five hundred and fifty-four, inclusive, known as "The Charter of the City of Baguio," is hereby made
applicable to the city of Baguio, Mountain Province, and shall have full force and effect therein.

All actions taken and things done prior to the enactment of this Act, with respect to carrying out
any of the provisions of the Administrative Code applying to the city of Baguio, are hereby legalized, ratified,
and confirmed.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 25, 1916.
